items.title: WISE — Web Integrated Search Engine
items.description: Architected a highly scalable hybrid RAG system handling over 15,000 corporate filings. Engineered a querying engine routing between vector search and NL-to-SQL, returning context-aware answers with low latency.

items.title: AI-Based Corporate Filings Parser
items.description: Designed an intelligent document processing pipeline extracting structured business data via dynamic Pydantic definitions. Implemented an "LLM-as-a-Judge" node to continuously evaluate extraction accuracy.

items.title: Podcast Generation Engine
items.description: Developed an automated B2B TTS pipeline transforming executive briefings into multi-speaker podcasts. Features contextual abbreviation expansion and artifact-free audio cloning.

items.title: Autonomous RFP & Tender Response Swarm
items.description: Architected a full-stack, multi-agent application to automate enterprise B2B proposal generation. Orchestrated a cyclical LangGraph swarm with a Pydantic state model to parse tender requirements and draft compliant technical responses autonomously.
